title: Reduced primary street setback for a portion of the frontage: minimum reduced setback
text: C3.3.2 Notwithstanding C3.3.1, the following reductions are permitted: i. the primary street setback line may be reduced for a portion of the frontage width in accordance with in Table 3.3b (refer Figure 3.3a). Table 3.3b Reduced street setback, reduced primary street setback: R10 - R12.5 5m; R15 - R25 4m; R30 - R35 3m; R40 2m.

replaces.note: R30-R40 'up to 1 m for 30% of frontage' -> Table 3.3b reduced setback
averaging of adjoining dwellings' setbacks deleted
50% compensated reduction replaced by a fixed reduced setback

verified.note: Values clear; Table 3.3b has no row for R50 and above. Draft's 'in accordance with in Table 3.3b' kept verbatim. Figure 3.3a is labelled 'HOUSE'.

notes: from: ch3 C3.3.2(i). Table 3.3b (p30): R10-R12.5 5 m, R15-R25 4 m, R30-R35 3 m, R40 2 m; no row for R50-R60. Applies only where a portion is built forward (reduced-portion width > 0); the width limit is C3.3.2(i)#r1. Figure 3.3a is labelled 'HOUSE' and the draft does not discuss apartment frontages (C4P1-078). Draft typo 'in accordance with in Table 3.3b'.
